name: devspec
description: DevSpec for Claude Code — shared team memory, live remote control from phone or web, and automatic task & commit provenance.

devspec_token.title: DevSpec API token
devspec_token.description: Your DevSpec API token with read_write scope. Create one on DevSpec's Agent setup page (https://app.devspec.ai/settings/agents): choose Create your token and pick Read & write. It starts with 'dvs_' and is account-wide — reuse the same token everywhere.

devspec_mcp_url.title: DevSpec server
devspec_mcp_url.description: Leave this as it is. It only changes if DevSpec ask you to point at a different server.

connect_at_startup.title: Make Claude Code available on DevSpec when it starts
connect_at_startup.description: When you start Claude Code in a folder linked to a DevSpec project, it appears on the Agents page straight away, ready for your team to send it work. It uses nothing while it waits. Turn this off to connect only when you run /devspec:devspec.remote.

monitors.name: devspec-remote
monitors.description: DevSpec: messages sent to this agent (load the devspec-remote-command skill once per conversation, then answer each)
